title: Build
gkm: To build a house; to build up.
refs: Except the LORD build the house, they labour in vain that build it
Through wisdom is an house builded; and by understanding it is established
A wise man, which built his house upon a rock
Intending to build a tower, sitteth not down first, and counteth the cost
note: Ken, 1 Nov: the K-Tech card (fish X004, Jude 1:20). The Greek is Jude's word, Strong's G2026. Ken, 3 Nov: nine verses on the back. Ken, 19 Nov: the Greek is now oikodomeo (G3618), the word in Matthew 7:24, in place of Jude's epoikodomeo (G2026).
